_comment: Cloudflare Load Balancer starter. ⚠️  COST NOTICE: LB bills per DNS query (currently ~$0.50 per million DNS queries on the LB endpoint, plus a per-LB monthly fee). For a single-origin app, this is often overkill — a Health Check + a static maintenance Pages site as a Worker fallback may serve you cheaper. Verify pricing at https://www.cloudflare.com/plans/load-balancing/ before applying.

load_balancer.name: {{lb_hostname}}
load_balancer._note: FQDN that public traffic resolves to. Replace any existing A/AAAA/CNAME for this hostname with a 'Cloudflare Load Balancer' record.
load_balancer._steering_options_note: off (round-robin by weight) | geo (per-region pool list) | dynamic_latency (lowest live RTT) | proximity (closest to user, default for global apps) | random | least_outstanding_requests (Enterprise)
load_balancer._session_affinity_options_note: none | cookie (sets __cflb cookie, sticks user to one origin) | ip_cookie (cookie + IP fallback). Cookie affinity adds a ~24h sticky window — required for stateful uploaded sessions, breaks per-region cache locality.

pools.name: primary
pools._note: Primary pool. Healthy-traffic destination. Latitude/longitude help proximity steering.

pools.name: standby
pools._note: Warm standby. Take over if primary fails. Set weight=1 for active-active, weight=0 to keep cold until manually failed-over.

pools.name: static-fallback
pools._note: Last-resort fallback. Point at a Cloudflare Pages 'maintenance' deployment — a single static HTML that says 'we're updating'. Costs nothing and keeps the brand looking professional during full outages.
